]> 18/08/2026 7:09 Groomers, Interschools and Night Skiing!.

Today at Perisher is shaping up cloudy with a top of 8 degrees and northerly winds up to 22km/h, though we should hopefully see the sun peek through at times!

There are 52 groomed runs and 38 lifts spinning across the resort today. Underfoot, expect firm, fast conditions on a hard-packed snow base.

State Interschools continues today, and best of luck to all competing! To our other guests: most Interschools races will be taking place on Front Valley and Centre Valley, so today could be a great time to explore our other resort areas.

Night Skiing and Boarding is also on tonight from 6:00pm to 8:30pm! Experience Perisher after dark with V8 laps, live music and a stunning fireworks display (weather dependent).

Have a great day out there!
